messages:
marta (PM): Need fast decision: ACME pilot launch target 2026-04-01. We must lock minimal scope and assign owners for three blockers: runtime KV change, tenant CMK, staging prewarm. Quick replies pls.

alex (Eng): I can own runtime KV. Need a short acceptance checklist. Can we do canary without CMK temporarily?

sam (Runtime): Temporary canary OK only with documented fallback and audit events. Note: KV change may add ~8ms p95; will bench.

jess (Infra): Prewarm choices: burstable hosted (fast, quota ~3d) or dedicated pool (1wk+). Recommend burstable to hit date.

casey (SRE): If burstable, set alert: sustained_utilization >70% for 2h -> conversion runbook. Ill own runbook. Also flag maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC.

li (Security): CMK onboarding requires HSM + rotation policy review; earliest security slot 2026-03-18. If canary runs without CMK, provide data-separation design + in-transit encryption proof.

alex (Eng): Draft checklist: 1) E2E on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure validated; 3) staging p95 <120ms; 4) rollback flag.

marta (PM): Add security sign-off (li) and infra prewarm applied (jess). Action owners/due dates: alex  delivery plan + rollback (Thu COB); sam  perf matrix (Fri EOD); jess  open quota (today); li  design doc for review (Thu noon); casey  alert & runbook (today). Reply with "ack" on your line.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack  will post perf results to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack  opening INFRA ticket now

casey (SRE): ack  will include maintenance block in runbook

li (Security): ack  will slot review after doc posted

marta (PM): Thanks, I'll publish a one-page launch checklist after Thu updates.
